S2.name: Delusional Runway
S2.description: Buffs granted to the caster are applied as undispellable. When attacked, damage suffered in one attack does not exceed {{variable}} of max Health. At the start of the turn, has a 20% chance for each buff granted to the caster to grant ++cascade++. Cascade can only be granted once every 2 turns.

S3.name: Heart Over Grace
S3.description: Throws chocolates filled with heartfelt sentiments, granting ++increased Attack++ and ++increased Speed++ to all allies for 3 turns.

S1.name: Lunge
S1.description: Attacks the enemy in an act of faith, with a {{variable}} chance to stun for 1 turn. When it is not the caster's turn, effect chance increases by 20%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Chivalry
S2.description: Grants {{variable}} damage share from the damage received by the ally in the back row. At the moment the ally in the back row is attacked, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 15% and has a 35% chance to counterattack.

S3.name: Oath of Protection
S3.description: Swears an oath of protection, dispelling all debuffs from the caster and one ally, before ++increasing Defense++ for 3 turns.

S1.name: Sundering Slash
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, inflicting up to 10% injuries, before granting a ++barrier++ (proportional to the caster’s max Health) to the caster for 1 turn. When triggered as a counterattack, changes into an attack that targets all enemies.

S2.name: Wandering Eidolon
S2.description: At the start of battle and at the end of the turn, grants ++counterattack++ for 1 turn. At the end of an enemy's turn, gains 10 Fighting Spirit, and when Fighting Spirit is full, dispels all debuffs before increasing Combat Readiness by {{variable}}.

S3.name: Sword of Requiem
S3.description: Attacks all enemies by unleashing the power of the demonic sword, before consuming all Fighting Spirit. Inflicts 5,000 additional damage, regardless of whether the attack hits, and additional damage increases proportional to the amount of consumed Fighting Spirit, up to 10,000. When this skill is not on cooldown, when attacked, grants 30% damage reduction.

S1.name: Shield Thrust
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword and shield, with a {{variable}} chance each to dispel one buff twice. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Escort
S2.description: At the start of battle and at the end of the caster's turn, grants ++escort++ to the caster for 1 turn. After an ally except for the caster is attacked by a Single Attack, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by {{variable}}.

S3.name: Judgment of Light
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a shield, dispelling all buffs and a {{variable}} chance to stun for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Zippity Zap!
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a spear, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%. When it is the caster's turn, gains 1 Focus. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Wild Charge
S2.description: Increases Critical Hit Chance by {{variable}}. At the start of the turn, gains 1 Focus and grants ++Bzzt!++ to the caster for 1 turn, and when Focus is full, resets cooldown of Operation: Cream Pastry.

S3.name: Operation: Cream Pastry
S3.description: Attacks the enemy using adaptable tactics, inflicting up to 25% injuries. When Focus is full, consumes all to recover Health of the caster, and a successful attack will inflict additional damage equivalent to 60% of injuries inflicted on the target. Damage dealt and amount recovered increase proportional to the caster's max Health.

S1.name: Ankle Cut
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%.

S2.name: Blade Gust
S2.description: Attacks all enemies with a blade gust, with an 80% chance to make them unable to be buffed for 2 turns. When there are three or fewer enemies, damage dealt increases with fewer enemies.

S3.name: Gliding Slash
S3.description: Attacks the enemy repeatedly, granting ++Weakness Shared++ to the caster for 2 turns, before absorbing some of the damage dealt as Health. A critical hit has a {{variable}} chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

S1.name: Rapid Fire
S1.description: Attack the enemy by shooting, and increases Combat Readiness of the ally with the highest Combat Readiness except for the caster by {{variable}}. At the end of the turn detonates bomb effects inflicted on the target.

S2.name: Vampire Hunter
S2.description: At the start of the turn, dispels ++immortality++ from all enemies. Ignores Effect Resistance. At the end of someone's turn, when an enemy has ++immortality++, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by {{variable}}.

S3.name: Chain Explosion
S3.description: Attacks the enemy, dispelling two buffs before inflicting bomb for 2 turns. A critical hit will grant an extra turn.

S1.name: Hilag's Pride
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a lance, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict decreased Defense for 2 turns.

S2.name: Maelstrom Waltz
S2.description: Attacks all enemies by infiltrating deep into enemy lines.

S3.name: Promised Glory
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by rushing them down, and grants ++immunity++ to all allies for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the target's max Health.

S1.name: Quick Fire
S1.description: Rapidly shoots the enemy, with a {{variable}} chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

S2.name: Precise Attack
S2.description: Fires a missile at the enemy, and when the enemy is defeated, inflicts extinction. Hit Chance is increased by 15% when using this skill.

S3.name: Limiter Release
S3.description: Releases the limiter, granting ++increased Attack (Greater)++ and ++Critical Hit Chance++ to the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Basic Shot
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by shooting arrows, with a {{variable}} chance to target for 2 turns.

S2.name: Concentrated Fire
S2.description: Fires arrows at the enemy to attack, dispelling one buff. When the caster has a buff, triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

S3.name: Shock Arrow
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by shooting lightning arrows, inflicting silence for 2 turns and decreasing Combat Readiness by 100%. Grants a ++barrier++ (proportional to the caster's level) to the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Spiral Cut
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a machete, with a {{variable}} chance to decrease Defense for 1 turn.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases effect chance to 100%, and decreases Defense of the target for 2 turns.

S2.name: Natural Storyteller
S2.description: After an ally uses an attack that targets all enemies, activates Continuous Strike against the enemy with the highest Combat Readiness. Continuous Strike: Attacks the enemy, decreasing Combat Readiness by 20%, and increases Combat Readiness of the ally with the highest Combat Readiness except for the caster by 20%.

S3.name: Narrative Retcon
S3.description: Plants a bomb on all enemies and decreases Speed for 2 turns.

S1.name: Overpower
S1.description: Attacks the enemy, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict burn for 1 turn. When Merciless Execution is on cooldown, activates Annihilate instead of Overpower. Annihilate: Attacks the enemy, inflicting burn for 1 turn, and at the end of the turn, detonates burn effects inflicted on the target.
S1.soulburn_effect: Inflicts an additional burn effect for 1 turn.

S2.name: Operational Readiness
S2.description: Increases Effectiveness by {{variable}}. When attacking, cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow. At the start of the first battle, grants ++explosives++ to the ally in the back row except for the caster.

S3.name: Merciless Execution
S3.description: Attacks all enemies, with a {{variable}} chance to burn for 2 turns, and at the end of the turn, detonates burn effects and bombs inflicted on the target.

S1.name: Lunging Slash
S1.description: Attacks the enemy, with a {{variable}} chance to decrease Defense for 1 turn. When used on the caster's turn, activate Dazzling Slash as an extra attack if the caster is buffed. Dazzling Slash: Swiftly attacks the enemy, inflicting restrict for 1 turn.

S2.name: Assault Coordination
S2.description: After attacking four times, grants a ++barrier++ to all allies for 2 turns and increases Combat Readiness by 15%. Barrier strength increases proportional to the target's max Health.

S3.name: Battle Cry
S3.description: Raises the morale of all allies, granting ++immunity++ for 2 turns and decreasing debuff durations by 1 turn.
S3.soulburn_effect: Extends duration of buffs granted by this skill by 1 turn.

S1.name: Oopsie!
S1.description: Accidentally spills bread to attack the enemy, and triggers a Dual Attack from a random ally, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by {{variable}}.
S1.soulburn_effect: Combat Readiness increase effect will be applied to all allies.

S2.name: No Bullying!
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, gains {{variable}} Fighting Spirit, and when the foremost ally except for the caster is an Earth elemental Hero, gains 40 additional Fighting Spirit, before granting ++Special Friendship++ to the target. After being attacked, gains 20 Fighting Spirit and when Fighting Spirit is full, consumes all to dispel all debuffs from the caster before activating Help! Help!: Attacks all enemies, and grants an extra turn to the caster. A successful attack deals additional damage equivalent to 15% of max Health of the caster and the foremost ally except for the caster.

S3.name: Snack Time!
S3.description: Stops fighting and takes a break, dispelling all debuffs from all allies and increasing Combat Readiness by {{variable}}. Stops fighting and takes a break, dispelling all debuffs from all allies and granting ++continuous healing++ for 2 turns before increasing Combat Readiness by {{variable}}.

S1.name: Vampirism
S1.description: Claws the enemy, before absorbing some of the damage as Health.

S2.name: Vengeful Strike
S2.description: Attacks the enemy, decreasing Combat Readiness by {{variable}}.

S3.name: Spiteful Annihilation
S3.description: Attacks the enemy, dispelling all buffs and making them unable to be buffed for 2 turns, before ++increasing Attack++ and ++Defense++ of the caster for 2 turns.
S3.soulburn_effect: Extends duration of buffs granted by this skill by 1 turn.

S1.name: Lightning Kicks
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with kicks and dispels one buff.

S2.name: Advent of the Sura
S2.description: After an ally uses a non-attack skill, activates Swallow Kick on the enemy with the highest Defense. Swallow Kick: Attacks the enemy by leaping forward, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%. Penetrates the target’s Defense by 50%. When the caster is granted ++vigor++, grants an extra turn.

S3.name: Argent Flash
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a water scooter, and increases Combat Readiness of the ally in the back row by 50%. Grants ++vigor++ to the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Mirror Fragment
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a mirror, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict a random debuff for 1 turn. When Mirror of the Abyss is on cooldown, triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

S2.name: Consuming Grasp
S2.description: After inflicting rupture on all enemies for 2 turns, attacks all enemies and has a {{variable}} chance to inflict restrict for 2 turns. Grants ++stealth++ and a ++barrier++ (proportional to the Level) to the caster for 2 turns.

S3.name: Mirror of the Abyss
S3.description: Traps all enemies in a timeless space beyond the mirror, dispelling two buffs before inflicting a random debuff for 1 turn. Increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%.

S1.name: Divine Punishment
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with divine lightning and has a {{variable}} chance to inflict fear for 1 turn, before recovering Health of all allies proportional to the target's max Health.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases effect chance to 100%, and attacks all enemies. This attack does not trigger a Dual Attack.

S2.name: Scales of Equity
S2.description: At the start of battle, grants ++offering++ to the foremost ally. When the ally granted ++offering++ dies, recovers Health of all allies by 50%. When Combat Readiness of an enemy increases during battle, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by {{variable}} of the amount of Combat Readiness increased. This effect will not be applied to the Combat Readiness increase effect triggered by the same skill.

S3.name: The Caress of Mercy
S3.description: With the Goddess's authority, dispels all debuffs from all allies before increasing Combat Readiness by {{variable}}. Consumes 20% of the current Health of the ally granted ++offering++, granting ++abundance++ to all other allies for 2 turns.

S1.name: Horizontal Slash
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, and absorbs some of the damage dealt as Health. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Surpressed Desire
S2.description: Increases Evasion of all allies by 30%, and when an ally except for the caster evades, counterattacks. After attacking, when Fighting Spirit is full, consumes all, granting ++Demon Blade Unleashed++ to the caster for 1 turn before activating Blade Art: Bewitching Blossom. Blade Art: Bewitching Blossom: Consumes all Health to attack all enemies, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's lost Health.

S3.name: Rouge Aroma
S3.description: Dispels all buffs from all enemies before inflicting beguile and inflicting decreased Hit Chance for 2 turns. Ignores Effect Resistance of targets with less max Health than the caster.

S1.name: Sacred Blade
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword blast. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Chains of Binding
S2.description: After inflicting seal and collapse on the enemy for 2 turns, attacks the enemy. A critical hit will grant an extra turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S3.name: Goddess's Judgement
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with divinity and penetrates the target's Defense. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. Damage dealt increases with fewer enemies. At the start of the first battle, grants ++Sacred Covenant++ for 5 turns.

S1.name: Hide in the Shadows
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by swinging a sword, and has a {{variable}} chance to grant ++stealth++ to the caster for 1 turn.

S2.name: Aegis of Time
S2.description: At the start of battle, grants ++increased Critical Hit Resistance++ to all allies for 1 turn. Upon dying, revives with {{variable}} Health.

S3.name: Once-in-a-Life Research
S3.description: (Before Enhancement) Dispels all debuffs from all allies except for the caster and recovers Health before granting ++barrier++ for 2 turns. Amount recovered and barrier strength increase proportional to the caster's max Health. Grants ++solution++ to the caster and decreases skill cooldowns by 2 turns. (After Enhancement) Grants time reversal to all allies except for the caster and grants a ++barrier++ proportional to the caster's max Health to all allies except for the caster for 2 turns.

S1.name: Ordinary Offensive Magic
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with magic, and grants ++immunity++ to the caster for 1 turn. When it is the caster's turn, activates Vollzanbel as an extra attack. Vollznabell (gain 1 Soul): Attacks all enemies with flame magic. Damage dealt increases proportional to the amount of the enemy's lost Health.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases damage dealt of Ordinary Offensive Magic.

S2.name: The Highest Form of Magic
S2.description: At the start of battle, grants 40% resource increase to all allies. During battle, when Soul is 4 or higher, grants ++Defensive Magic++. After being attacked, increases Combat Readiness of all allies by {{variable}}

S3.name: Judradjim
S3.description: After granting ++increased Attack++ to the caster for 3 turns, attacks all enemies with lightning magic, dispelling all buffs. Penetrates the target's Defense by 50%.

S1.name: The Spell to Kill Demons
S1.description: After granting ++increased Attack++ to the caster for 1 turn, attacks the enemy with magic. When Focus is 3 or higher, decreases skill cooldowns by 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.
S1.soulburn_effect: Attacks all enemies. This attack does not trigger a Dual Attack or counterattack.

S2.name: Exceptional Magical Talent
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, gains 3 Focus. Increases Speed by 15% and Evasion by 20% for each Focus. When successfully evading, consumes 1 Focus and decreases skill cooldowns by 1 turn.

S3.name: The Spell to Kill Demons - Release
S3.description: After granting ++increased Attack++ to the caster for 1 turn, attacks the enemy with The Spell to Kill Demons. Penetrates the enemy's Defense by 70%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed. Begins the first battle with a full skill cooldown count.

S1.name: Vanguard's Strike
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with an axe and inflicts provoke for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Master's Lessons
S2.description: When an ally is attacked, gains 10 Fighting Spirit, and when Fighting Spirit is full, activates Warrior's Strike on the attacker. Warrior's Strike (consumes 100 Fighting Spirit): Attacks the enemy consecutively, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50% before resetting cooldown of Lightning Strike. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S3.name: Lightning Strike
S3.description: Attacks the enemy by slamming down with an axe. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. Damage dealt increases every time this skill is used, stacking up to 3 times.

S1.name: Spirit Burst
S1.description: Attacks two enemies with a burst and has a {{variable}} chance to dispel one buff.
S1.soulburn_effect: Increases effect chance to 100% and ignores Effect Resistance.

S2.name: Guidance of Nature
S2.description: At the start of an ally's extra turn, gains 2 Focus and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 30%. After using a skill, when Focus is full, activates Wings of Liberation. Wings of Liberation(consumes 5 Focus): Attacks all enemies by unleashing a spirit bird. Increases Hit Chance by 50% when using this skill, and is unaffected by elemental disadvantage.

S3.name: Blossoming Hope
S3.description: By kindling the light of hope, grants ++invincibility++ to all allies for 1 turn .

S1.name: This'll Sting!
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a scalpel, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict two bleeding effects for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates bleeding effects inflicted on the target,
S1.soulburn_effect: Grants an extra attack with the same skill.

S2.name: There, It'll Feel Better
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, increases Attack proportional to max Health. At the start of an ally's turn, dispels one debuff from the target and recovers Health proportional to the caster's max Health.

S3.name: It's Time to Be Reborn!
S3.description: Dispels all debuffs from an ally except for the caster before fully recovering Health. Grants ++superhumanization++ to the target for 3 turns and increases Combat Readiness by 50%. This skill is unaffected by cooldown increase and decrease effects.

S1.name: Repel
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with a chain axe, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict decreased Defense for 1 turn. When the caster is granted ++rage++, activates Eradication as an extra attack. Eradication: Attacks the enemy, inflicting bleed for 2 turns, and at the end of the turn, detonates bleed effects inflicted on the target. Ignores Effect Resistance.

S2.name: Abyss Observer
S2.description: At the start of battle and at the end of the turn, grants ++stealth++ to the caster for 1 turn. At the end of someone's turn, when an enemy is inflicted with provoke or redirected provoke, grants ++rage++ to the caster for 2 turns and increases Combat Readiness by {{variable}}.

S3.name: Unexpected Accident
S3.description: Attacks all enemies by staging an accident, inflicting three bleeding effects for 1 turn. When the target is inflicted with provoke or redirected provoke, extends duration of bleed inflicted on the target by 1 turn. When the caster is granted ++rage++, ignores Effect Resistance.

S1.name: Crimson Claws
S1.description: After inflicting rupture on the enemy for 1 turn, attacks the enemy. A successful attack always results in a critical hit. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. When the caster is granted ++immortality++, triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

S2.name: Noias's Guidance
S2.description: At the start of battle, grants ++immortality++ for 1 turn. When granted ++immortality++, increases Effect Resistance by 200%. When someone uses a Soulburn, dispels all debuffs from the caster before activating Dark Moon. Dark Moon: Dispels two buffs from all enemies, before granting ++immortality++ to the caster for 3 turns and increases Combat Readiness by {{variable}}.

S3.name: Endless Darkness
S3.description: After inflicting seal on all enemies for 1 turn, attacks them and decreases Combat Readiness by 30%. A successful attack always results in a critical hit. When the caster is granted ++immortality++, ignores Effect Resistance. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health.
